Row.Text: Has unlimited movements, must complete the city movement within one turn, otherwise it will return to the original position.

Replace.Text: 拥有无限移动力，必须在当回合内完成城市移动，否则会回到原位。

Row.Text: Pack your entire city! This will create the unit 'city on wheels'. This unit has unlimited movements and can settle at a better location. Districts and buildings in this city will be copied, except for the world wonders. District will be completed immediately once you choose where it will be placed.

Replace.Text: 打包这个城市！创建新单位“打包好的城市”，这个单位拥有无限的移动力，可以立刻把城市移动到一个更好的地方！城市中的已经建好的区域和建筑将被拷贝到新城市，世界奇观除外。建过的区域在选择好单元格之后将立即完成。
